answer: Cosignatures are collected in thread, verified in raven, and whisper names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 35 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 210 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
